title: Samsung Galaxy watch feature request
symptom: Users report that after updating to the latest nightly build, xDrip notifications became persistent and can no longer be dismissed, so they are no longer forwarded to Samsung Galaxy/Gear watches. Previously, notifications were dismissable and updated every 5 minutes, allowing glucose readings and graphs to appear on the watch.
cause: The change in notification behavior (from dismissable to persistent) in a nightly build caused the notifications to stop being sent to Tizen-based Samsung watches.
fix: No official fix was provided. Workarounds include using the Wearable Widgets app to display the xDrip widget on the watch, or using a combination of Tasker and AutoNotification with Watchmaker (as described in a guide by FreDiabetics). Some users downgraded to the 7/15/18 version of xDrip to restore notification forwarding.
evidence_quote: I've been begging for that to be fixed, for months now (I first posted Aug 13, 2018). If you use the 7/15/18 version, notifications to a Tizen watch will work--I don't know about to other watch OS's.
